title: Shrek's Revenge
description: A mod that adds the ogre, shrek to your game! Beware, he's very angry...
body:
Shrek’s Revenge brings an angry Shrek into your Minecraft world, and he’s not happy. This massive ogre will attack on sight, but there’s a way to calm him down. If you can get the Shreksophone by killing him, you might be able to make him friendly. Shrek can appear anywhere, but his strength increases dramatically when he’s in the swamp. Can you manage to stay out of his way or find the right way to calm him down?

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.


</details>



![Shrek](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/292ea7240b56dbd4efdc8c7f0e2ce95e3bebc634.png)

Shrek can spawn in almost any biome, except those that are too hot or cold. If Shrek spots you, he’ll give you a friendly wave, before charging in to attack. He’s strong and durable, but in swamps and mangrove biomes, he becomes even more powerful, gaining Strength and Regeneration. Defeating Shrek can drop Onions and a Shreksophone. The Shreksophone lets you play music or right-click Shrek to turn him neutral. When neutral, Shrek constantly plays the Shreksophone and protects players by attacking hostile mobs.

 

- Config File not inculed.
